sn12.33:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Catucattārīsaṃ vo bhikkhave ñāṇavatthūni desissāmi || Taṃ suṇātha sādhukam manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti || || Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosum || || Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn12.33:2.1: Katamāni ca bhikkhave catucattārīsam ñāṇavatthūni || || Jarāmaraṇe ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇasamudaye ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhe ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || Jātiyā ñāṇaṃ jātisamudaye ñāṇaṃ jātinirodhe ñāṇaṃ jātinirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || Bhave ñāṇaṃ bhavasamudaye ñāṇaṃ bhavanirodhe ñāṇaṃ bhavanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || Upādāne ñāṇaṃ upādānasamudaye ñāṇaṃ upādānanirodhe ñāṇaṃ upādānanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || Taṇhāya ñāṇaṃ vedanāsamudaye ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhe ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || Vedanāya ñāṇaṃ vedanāsamudaye ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhe ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || Phasse ñāṇaṃ || || Saḷāyatane ñāṇaṃ || || Nāmarūpe ñāṇaṃ || || Viññāne ñāṇaṃ || || Saṅkhāresu ñāṇaṃ saṅkhārasamudaye ñāṇaṃ saṅkhāranirodhe ñāṇaṃ saṅkhāranirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || Imāni vuccanti bhikkhave catucattārīsaṃ ñāṇavatthūni || ||
sn12.33:3.1: Katamañca bhikkhave jarāmaraṇam || || Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīranatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccam valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko || ayam vuccati jarā || || Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccumaraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānam bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo || idaṃ vuccati maraṇaṃ || Iti ayañca jarā idañca maraṇaṃ || idam vuccati bhikkhave jarāmaraṇaṃ || ||
sn12.33:4.1: Jātisamudayā jarāmaraṇasamudayo || jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho || ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā || seyyathīdam || Sammādiṭṭhi || pa || sammāsamādhi || ||
sn12.33:5.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako evaṃ jarāmaraṇam pajānāti || evaṃ jarāmaraṇasamudayam pajānāti || evaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodham pajānāti || evaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminim paṭipadam pajānāti || || Idhamassa dhamme ñāṇaṃ || so iminā dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ neti ||
sn12.33:6.1: Ye kho keci atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā jarāmaraṇam abbhaññaṃsu || jarāmaraṇasamudayam abbhaññaṃsu || jarāmaraṇanirodham abbhaññaṃsu || jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminim paṭipadam abbhaññaṃsu || sabbe te evam evam abbhaññaṃsu || Seyyathāpaham etarahi || ||
sn12.33:7.1: Ye hi pi keci anāgatam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā jarāmaraṇam abhijānissanti || jarāmaraṇasamudayam abhijānissanti || jarāmaraṇanirodham abhijānissanti || jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminim paṭipadam abhijānissanti || sabbe te evam evam abhijānissanti || seyyathāpaham etarahīti || idam assa anvaye ñāṇaṃ || ||
sn12.33:8.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni dve ñāṇāni parisuddhāni honti pariyodātāni dhamme ñāṇaṃ ca anvaye ñāṇaṃ ca || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno iti pi || dassanasampanno iti pi || āgato imaṃ saddhammam iti pi || passati imaṃ saddhammam iti pi || sekhena ñāṇena samannāgato iti pi || sekhāya vijjāya samannāgato iti pi || dhammasotaṃ samāpanno iti pi || ariyo nibbedhikapāñño iti pi || amatadvāram āhacca tiṭṭhati iti pīti || pe||
sn12.33:9.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave jāti || yā tesam || || Katamo ca bhikkhave bhavo || Katamaṃ ca bhikkhave upādānaṃ || Katamā ca bhikkhave taṇhā || Katamā ca bhikkhave vedanā || Katamo ca bhikkhave phasso || Katamaṃ ca bhikkhave saḷāyatanam || Katamaṃ ca bhikkhave nāmarūpaṃ || Katamaṃ ca bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ || Katame ca bhikkhave saṅkhārā || || Tayo me bhikkhave saṅkhārā || kāyasaṅkhāro vacīsaṅkhāro cittasaṅkhāro ti || ime vuccanti bhikkhave saṅkhārā || ||
sn12.33:10.1: Avijjāsamudayā saṅkhārasamudayo || avijjāsamudayanirodhā saṅkhāranirodho || ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā || seyyathīdaṃ || Sammādiṭṭhi || pe|| sammāsamādhi || ||
sn12.33:11.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako evaṃ saṅkhāre pajānāti || evaṃ saṅkhārasamudayam pajānāti || evaṃ saṅkhāranirodham pajānāti || evaṃ saṅkharā nirodhagaminiṃ paṭipadam pajānāti || idam assa dhamme ñāṇaṃ || || So iminā dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ neti || ||
sn12.33:12.1: Ye kho keci atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saṅkhare abbhaññaṃsu saṅkharasamudayam abbhaññaṃsu || saṅkhāranirodham abbhaññaṃsu || sabbe te evam evam abbhaññaṃsu seyyathāpaham etarahi ||
sn12.33:13.1: Ye pi hi keci anāgatam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saṅkhāre abhijānissanti || saṅkhārasamudayam abhijānissanti || saṅkhāranirodham abhijānissanti || saṅkhāranirodhagāminim paṭipadam abhijānissanti || sabbe te evam evam abhijānissanti || seyyathāpaham etarahi || Idam assa anvaye ñāṇaṃ ||
sn12.33:14.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni dve ñāṇāni parisuddhāni honti pariyodātāni dhamme ñāṇaṃ ca anvaye ñāṇaṃ ca || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave āriyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno iti pi || dassanasampanno iti pi || āgato imaṃ saddhammam iti pi || passati imaṃ saddhammam iti pi || sekhena ñāṇena samannāgato iti pi || sekhayā vijjāya samannāgato iti pi || dhammasotam samāpanno iti pi || ariyo nibbedhikapañño iti pi || amatadvāram āhacca tiṭṭhati iti pīti || || Tatiyaṃ || ||
